scope: Four predeclared full-validation interventions; W5 vocabularies fixed; no MK/test/training/export/publication.

hyperparameters.sampler: four sequential torch.randperm(256) draws from one seeded CPU Generator
hyperparameters.overflow_policy: retry same scheduled window without optimizer update; stop above8 skipped attempts
hyperparameters.selection: final1024 successful updates only; no validation during training
hyperparameters.initialization: norm_compensation_v1 exported FP16 small tensors; fresh optimizer and scaler
hyperparameters.training_data: 256 disjoint train windows excluding all32 original calibration windows
hyperparameters.stability: native FP16 casts and native A/dt formulas; finite checks; no new clamps or reparameterization

small_overlay_receipt.storage_scope: 116 original inherited files plus the full393-tensor replacement. Norm-v1 initialization, training data/checkpoints, tokenizer, code/licenses and reports are not included in these raw byte counts.

fixed_vocabularies: parent W5 embedding and W5 lm_head in every arm

environment.gpu: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition

original_small_e8.score: next-token cross entropy; no BOS/EOS added; each window starts from zero state

trained_small_e8.score: next-token cross entropy; no BOS/EOS added; each window starts from zero state

original_small_source.score: next-token cross entropy; no BOS/EOS added; each window starts from zero state

limitations: Source-projection interventions are FP16 storage oracles, not achieved E8 repairs.
Validation has already informed development; this is not untouched test evidence.
PPL does not establish MK recall; no MK runs or recall claims are included.
Source PPL from the previous report is historical; no true-source fifth arm is added.
GPU allocation is expanded FP16 reference residency; timings are not throughput measurements.

scoring_protocol.state: zero state per window; native SSD scan internal precision
scoring_protocol.loss: frozen evaluation.py FP16 head products then FP32 summed cross entropy

source_package_receipt.format: original BF16 checkpoint cast to requested dtype
